001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api;
002
003import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
004
005import java.util.function.Consumer;
006
007/**
008 * Utilities to help QuickShop quickly check server supported features
009 *
010 * @author Ghost_chu and sandtechnology
011 */
012public enum GameVersion {
013  v1_20_R1(new String[]{ "1.20", "1.20.1" }, true, true, true, true, false),
014  v1_20_R2(new String[]{ "1.20.2", "1.20.3" }, true, true, true, true, false),
015  v1_20_R3(new String[]{ "1.20.4", "1.20.5" }, true, true, true, true, true),
016  v1_20_R4(new String[]{ "1.20.6" }, true, true, true, true, true),
017  v1_21_R1(new String[]{ "1.21", "1.21.1" }, true, false, true, true, true),
018  v1_21_R2(new String[]{ "1.21.2", "1.21.3" }, true, false, true, true, true),
019  v1_21_R3(new String[]{ "1.21.4" }, true, false, true, true, true),
020  v1_21_R4(new String[]{ "1.21.5" }, true, false, true, true, true),
021  v1_21_R5(new String[]{ "1.21.6" }, true, false, true, true, true),
022  v1_21_R6(new String[]{ "1.21.7", "1.21.8", "1.21.9" }, true, false, true, true, true),
023  v1_21_R9(new String[]{ "1.21.10" }, true, false, true, true, true),
024  v1_21_R10(new String[]{ "1.21.11" }, true, false, true, true, true),
025  v26_1(new String[]{ "26.1", "26.1.1", "26.1.2" }, true, false, true, true, true),
026  v26_2(new String[]{ "26.2" }, true, false, true, true, true),
027  UNKNOWN(new String[0], true, false, false, true, true);
028  private final String[] mcVersion;
029  /**
030   * CoreSupports - Check does QuickShop most features supports this server version
031   */
032  private final boolean coreSupports;
033
034  /**
035   * EndOfLife - It will disable update checker or some else checks
036   */
037  private final boolean endOfLife;
038
039  /**
040   * VirtualDisplaySupports - Check does QuickShop VirtualDisplayItem feature this server version
041   */
042  private final boolean virtualDisplaySupports;
043
044  /**
045   * NewNmsName - Use 1.17+ nms class name mapping
046   */
047  private final boolean newNmsName;
048
049  private final boolean newPotionAPI;
050
051  GameVersion(final String[] mcVersion, final boolean coreSupports, final boolean endOfLife, final boolean virtualDisplaySupports, final boolean newNmsName, final boolean newPotionAPI) {
052
053    this.mcVersion = mcVersion;
054    this.coreSupports = coreSupports;
055    this.endOfLife = endOfLife;
056    this.virtualDisplaySupports = virtualDisplaySupports;
057    this.newNmsName = newNmsName;
058    this.newPotionAPI = newPotionAPI;
059  }
060
061
062  /**
063   * Matches the version that QuickShop supports or not
064   *
065   * @param nmsVersion The Minecraft NMS version
066   *
067   * @return The object contains supports details for GameVersion
068   */
069  @NotNull
070  public static GameVersion get(@NotNull final String nmsVersion) {
071
072    return get(nmsVersion, null);
073  }
074
075  public static GameVersion get(@NotNull final String nmsVersion, final Consumer<Boolean> fallback) {
076
077    for (final GameVersion version : GameVersion.values()) {
078      if (version.name().equals(nmsVersion.trim())) {
079
080        if (fallback != null) {
081          fallback.accept(false);
082        }
083        return version;
084      }
085
086      for (final String str : version.mcVersion) {
087        if (str.trim().equalsIgnoreCase(nmsVersion.trim())) {
088          if (fallback != null) {
089            fallback.accept(false);
090          }
091          return version;
092        }
093      }
094    }
095
096    if (fallback != null) {
097      fallback.accept(true);
098    }
099    return v1_21_R10;
100  }
101
102  public String[] getMcVersion() {
103
104    return this.mcVersion;
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * CoreSupports - Check does QuickShop most features supports this server version
109   */
110  public boolean isCoreSupports() {
111
112    return this.coreSupports;
113  }
114
115  /**
116   * EndOfLife - It will disable update checker or some else checks
117   */
118  public boolean isEndOfLife() {
119
120    return this.endOfLife;
121  }
122
123  /**
124   * VirtualDisplaySupports - Check does QuickShop VirtualDisplayItem feature this server version
125   */
126  public boolean isVirtualDisplaySupports() {
127
128    return this.virtualDisplaySupports;
129  }
130
131  /**
132   * NewNmsName - Use 1.17+ nms class name mapping
133   */
134  public boolean isNewNmsName() {
135
136    return this.newNmsName;
137  }
138
139  public boolean isNewPotionAPI() {
140
141    return this.newPotionAPI;
142  }
143}
